changes: Bound native pre-dispatch service-proof wait to min(1s, original caller remaining budget minus min(250ms, 25%)); desktop acquisition consumes the same budget.
A pending proof cannot suppress a NOT_APPLIED ACK. Fence its serial dispatcher; late proof publishes only to its buffered result slot, never input or returned timings.
Keep Authority handle ownership and exact process/IPC/job retirement before recovery or replacement. No uncertain input retry, cached authority, longer lease or successful ACK changes.
Carry the fixed native_service_wait failed-ACK phase through the native client, journal and sanitized product log.

previousB.agentSampling: GC-trail sampling continued at about 100ms; the agent was not continuously stopped for 4 seconds

investigation.attribution: Historical records do not establish which Windows call stalled. An unbounded native service-proof join was reproduced and corrected; native desktop, SendInput and OS scheduling remain possible independent causes.

additionalA.scope: Separate capture cleanup failure, recovered during this installation; this patch does not claim to fix it.

validation.regression: Blocked fresh proof returns before deadline; 40ms caller returns at 30ms; no-deadline bound 1s; cancellation, permanent fencing, exactly one query, retained Authority pins, late success/timing isolation, negative ACK framing and phase, unknown already-started input preserved. Existing lost/malformed ACK and native retirement suites passed.
validation.testDevelopment: One new synctest initially blocked because RWMutex waits are not durably blocked; replaced that test rendezvous. A later assertion compared error pointer identity instead of preserved error chain/certainty; corrected the assertion. Final tests passed.
validation.frontend: 104/104 tests and native production build passed.
validation.package: Workspace archive, installer provenance and icon checks passed; application setup offline verification passed.

transfer.evidence: CLI send acknowledgement was unavailable across local maintenance restarts; later wait returned SAME_VERSION, not an UPDATED receipt. Matching authenticated peer generation/revision, successful B installation receipt, matching-build UI launch and protected-input READY independently establish installed state. No additional resend is inferred as necessary.

limitations: Post-install health/connection snapshot only; no proof that the original 4-second OS stall or the separate A capture cleanup fault cannot recur.
Each control.previous.jsonl is incomplete; absence of faults is limited to the retained settled current-build window.
A synchronous desktop/SendInput call or a process/OS scheduling stall is not made interruptible by the pre-dispatch proof bound.
